name: The Defias Traitor
summary: At Sentinel Hill, The Defias Traitor has given up the Brotherhood's hidden base to save his life. The captured outlaw is held beneath the watchtower after the People's Militia caught him stealing Farmer Saldean's wagon.

sections.title: Leading the Way to Moonbrook
sections.body: Under guard at Sentinel Hill's watchtower, the traitor must lead Alliance champions through hostile territory to the hidden entrance beneath ruined Moonbrook. His former comrades hate him, and his captors despise him. Yet his betrayal gives the People's Militia the opening it needs to strike at the Brotherhood's heart.

sections.title: A Bargain for Survival
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood does not command every member's loyalty to Edwin VanCleef. Gryan Stoutmantle's militia caught the petty thief trying to steal Farmer Saldean's wagon. Facing execution, he chose to save himself. He gave the militia the exact location of the Brotherhood's hidden base in exchange for his life.

aliases: who is the traitor at sentinel hill
faq.answer: The Defias Traitor is a former member of the Brotherhood, captured by the People's Militia while trying to steal Farmer Saldean's wagon. To escape execution, he agreed to lead Militia allies to the Brotherhood's hidden lair.

faq.q: Why is he standing outside the tower in Sentinel Hill?
aliases: why is he at sentinel hill
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia hold him outside their stronghold, under armed watch. He remains there until volunteers step forward to escort him to the Defias hideout.
He leads travelers southwest across Westfall's plains to the derelict town of Moonbrook, where he points out the concealed entrance to the Defias Hideout.

faq.q: Why did he turn against the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: He turned against the Brotherhood to save himself. Caught stealing from Farmer Saldean and facing execution, he offered the Brotherhood's greatest secret in exchange for his life.

angles.text: For the People's Militia and Westfall's defenders, this prisoner marks a turning point in their struggle against the outlaws terrorizing the region.
As a Rogue, you know how fragile loyalty can be among criminals. Cornered by the law, thieves and cutpurses may sell out their own.
